scenes.visual_description: POV: Hand pours a cup of ice cubes into the clear pitcher. Extreme close-up of ice hitting the bottom, pitcher on sleek stainless base. Fingers press the LED power button.
Top-down: Blades spin. Ice transforms to smooth texture in seconds. Pitcher vibrates gently—no face, just hands steadying.
POV: Hand adds spinach, fruit, and almond milk into pitcher. Measurement markings visible. LED speed dial turns smoothly.
Over-the-shoulder: Silky smoothie pours into glass. Another hand gently wipes countertop—no messy splashes.
Side-by-side: Blender running next to sleeping baby monitor (screen shows 'Zzz'), hands adjusting speed—whisper-quiet.
POV: Hand presses self-clean button. Close-up: pitcher rinses itself, parts placed in dishwasher rack.

call_to_action: Upgrade your kitchen. Tap to shop ProBlend 3000.
full_visual_description: Quick POV shots and close-ups: hands pour ice, spin blades, add ingredients, and operate controls on the ProBlend 3000. Show ice crushing, smooth blending, silent operation (baby monitor), self-clean function, and easy dishwasher cleanup. Sleek stainless steel finish and LED panel featured. No faces, only hands and arms interacting with product. Fast-paced, energetic edits.
